links.outcome: Local ambient scribe assessment of note quality, usability, time savings, and documentation fatigue
links.effect: Mean SUS 78.3; PU 5.65, PEOU 5.56; modified PDQI-8 4.3/5; 80.6% agreed documentation time reduced; 66.6% reported reduced documentation-related fatigue.
links.quote: Most participants (80.6%) agreed that using the AI scribe reduced time spent on documentation, while 66.6% reported a reduced perception of documentation-related fatigue.

links.outcome: Clinician-rated AI scribe note quality including thoroughness, completeness, and inaccuracies
links.effect: Modified PDQI-8 mean 4.3/5; thoroughness lowest (3.9, SD 1.0); a few participants reported incomplete notes, missing biopsychosocial details, and inaccuracies.
links.quote: A few participants reported that some notes were incomplete, lacked biopsychosocial details, and contained inaccuracies.

screen.reason: Prospective usability and user experience study evaluating the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe tool among 31 clinicians in specialized rehabilitation centers.
